# Menu Button

Open a command menu from one trigger and restore focus on dismissal.

## Usage

### Action menu

Create or import workspace resources from one compact trigger.

<ComponentExample component="menu-button" scenario="actions" title="Action menu" description="Create or import workspace resources from one compact trigger." :index="0" />

### Nested submenu

Keep secondary export formats inside the Export as command.

<ComponentExample component="menu-button" scenario="nested" title="Nested submenu" description="Keep secondary export formats inside the Export as command." :index="1" />

### Controlled

Let the parent own the current value and apply accepted changes back to the component.

<ComponentExample component="menu-button" scenario="controlled" title="Controlled" description="Let the parent own the current value and apply accepted changes back to the component." :index="2" />

## Floating positioning

This component uses the shared positioning engine. Use the [live positioning example](/guide/positioning) to change `side`, `align`, offsets, collision boundaries, strategy, and tracking while inspecting the resolved placement.

## Keyboard interaction

| Key | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Arrow Up</kbd> / <kbd>Arrow Down</kbd> | Move between items at the current menu level. |
| <kbd>Arrow Right</kbd> / <kbd>Arrow Left</kbd> | Open a submenu or return to its parent. |
| <kbd>Home</kbd> / <kbd>End</kbd> | Move to the first or last item at the current level. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | Open a submenu or invoke the current item. |
| <kbd>Escape</kbd> | Close the current menu level. |

## Accessibility

The trigger exposes popup and expanded state; the opened content uses menu semantics and returns focus on close.

See the [corresponding WAI-ARIA pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/menu-button/) for the host accessibility contract.
